description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests to set or retrieve user interface status indicators such as battery charge, internet connectivity, WiFi status, MoCA status, and firewall level. It manages session validation, gathers device status information via external functions, processes logic to classify battery levels, and outputs a JSON-encoded configuration with status tips.

methods.name: get_tips
methods.description: Generates user-friendly status tips based on device target type and current status.
